title: Imagined Speech EEG dataset comparing paradigm designs (Aguilera-Rodriguez et al. 2025)
description: An EEG dataset of imagined speech recorded from 15 healthy participants to compare traditional cue-based and gamified (Pac-Man maze) paradigm designs for brain-computer interface applications. It comprises 1,800 trials of four Spanish directional commands (avanzar, retroceder, derecha, izquierda), recorded with a 24-channel system at 500 Hz. This BIDS derivative, provided through MOABB, supports evaluation of how paradigm design affects imagined speech decoding.
methods_description: EEG was acquired from 15 healthy participants (ages 18-27) with a 24-channel mBrainTrain Smarting system at 500 Hz, FCz reference and Fpz ground. The traditional paradigm used visual and auditory cues (5 beeps at 1.4 s rhythm) followed by 7 imagined speech repetitions, of which the last 3 were kept. The gamified paradigm used a Pac-Man maze interface with 1.4 s periods for movement decision, imagined speech, and vocalized speech. Each participant completed 120 trials per session (30 per class).
